title: Webhook signature mismatch
summary: The receiver reserializes JSON before checking the signature.
search_query: webhook signature mismatch JSON reserialization raw body
finding: The mismatch comes from verifying changed payload bytes rather than the raw request body.
next_step: Compute HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body and compare it with the signature header.
